desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: Pet Tower!

Choose a door and build your pet one step at a time 🐾
Will your pet glow up… or get completely ruined?..

Every choice gives you new items:
🐶 fur styles, outfits, accessories
💀 or something that will DESTROY your pet's look
Reach the end and prove you've got the best pet style 🐾

🐾 Like the game + join the group for extra perks
